description: This file is a server-side script for managing tag-related functionality within a SvelteKit application. It includes a load function for fetching tags and multiple actions for creating, updating, archiving, and restoring tags, all utilizing an API helper for server requests.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches tags data with permission check for admin users. Loads tags including archived ones for admins.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new tag using form data, with validation for the tag name.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing tag identified by tagId with new data, with validation for the tag name.

methods.name: archive
methods.description: Archives (deletes) a tag identified by tagId.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a previously archived tag identified by tagId.
